requirements.description: The user wants the property near parks or green areas. Using the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26, rounded to 74), the unit should score at or above this level for green proximity.
User prefers an energy class D or better, so the filter includes D and every higher class (C, B, A1-A4).

User explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was provided by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class (D or better) and proximity to parks are not among the reference columns and are handled elsewhere.
